mutations.name: B06-private
mutations.old: s.present = true ∧ s.isPublic = true ∧ s.publicId = some key
mutations.new: s.present = true ∧ True ∧ s.publicId = some key

mutations.name: B06-cache-generation
mutations.old: if entry.generation = current ∧ entry.page = page then .cached current page
mutations.new: if True ∧ entry.page = page then .cached current page

mutations.name: B06-footprint-edit-owner
mutations.old: if mayEdit s e ∧ footprintEligible s memoryUpdates f then { f with publication := some copy }
mutations.new: if True ∧ footprintEligible s memoryUpdates f then { f with publication := some copy }
